sources.title: San Francisco-based Dropbox slashes 20% of workforce
sources.description: San Francisco-based Dropbox announced on Wednesday that it is slashing 20% of its workforce.

sources.title: Dropbox is laying off another 500 employees
sources.description: Dropbox is cutting 20pc of its workforce, or 528 employees, as the company goes through a ‘transitional period’, according to the CEO.

sources.title: Dropbox slashes 20% of global workforce, eliminating more than 500 roles
sources.description: The company is in a “transitional period” as its file sync and share business and its Dash artificial intelligence search feature mature.

sources.title: Tech layoffs: Dropbox removes 16% workforce, plans to hire new employees with AI skills - BusinessToday
sources.description: Dropbox had 3,118 full-time employees at the end of 2022, with 2,583 located in the United States

sources.title: Dropbox to Lay Off 500 Employees, Or About 16% of Its Workforce
sources.description: Dropbox is laying off 500 employees, or about 16% of its workforce, the company said.
